title: nan
authors: Jiang H.; Gu F.; He Y.; Bao Y.
key_contribution: Presents a tightly coupled derivative-enhanced camera-IMU-UWB fusion approach for GNSS-denied UAV navigation, validated on the EuRoC dataset with improved localization accuracy.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
